title: Connections
help: Environment values are locked. Save other settings here, then test the connection.
keepSecret: Leave unchanged to keep the stored secret.
locked: This value is managed by the environment.
secretSaveOnBlur: The secret will be saved when you leave this field.

validation.url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
validation.port: Enter a whole number between 1 and 65535.
validation.value: Check this value and its allowed length.
validation.locked: This value is managed by the environment.

testSent: Test message accepted by the notification service.
oidcChecked: OIDC discovery verified. Client credentials and the callback require an interactive sign-in.
webhookBlocked: Destination blocked. Approve its LAN host or network in the webhook connection settings. Loopback and link-local addresses are always blocked.
checkFailed: The connection test failed. Check the saved configuration and service availability.
notConfigured: Complete and enable the saved connection before testing it.
pushSubscriptionRequired: Enable browser notifications for this session in your account before testing.
checkHelp: Wait for the automatic save before testing the connection.
notificationCheckHelp: Uses saved settings and sends a test message: email to your account, webhook to its configured destination, or push to this browser session.
storageHelp: Values provided by the environment are locked. Other settings can be saved here. Changing storage settings does not move existing files.
authenticationHelp: Public registration requires password sign-in and creates Observer accounts. Keep OIDC configured before disabling password sign-in. Environment values lock their fields.
intervalHelp: 60–86400 seconds, in one-minute increments. Default: 60 seconds. Pausing automatic collection keeps explicit manual reads available.
